in_marathi.name: Vyan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vyan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Vyan is derived from the Sanskrit word 'vira', meaning 'hero' or 'manly'. In Hindu mythology, Vyan is a name for the god Indra, the king of the gods and the god of thunder, rain, and storms. Vyan represents power, strength, and courage.
